'''Pradoc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he sold specialized gear for [[Jedi Consular]]s in the Combat Training section of [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pradoc first appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a level 50 Battlemaster PVP Gear vendor.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
